About the Position

This PhD project, supervised by Dr S Romero-Vargas Castrillon, focuses on molecular engineering of water treatment membranes using computational methods and machine learning. The University of Edinburgh is seeking candidates for this PhD opportunity focused on Molecular Engineering of Water Treatment Membranes at University of Edinburgh. Disciplinary scope: Engineering, Chemistry, Physics. Location: Edinburgh, United Kingdom. According to the listing, funding is partial; financial support is listed as Competitive funding may be available for 3. Interested candidates should note the deadline: 2 March 2027.

Research Focus

  • Water Scarcity: Developing membranes for unconventional water treatment
  • Molecular Simulation: Using molecular dynamics to understand transport mechanisms
  • Machine Learning: Using ML for materials discovery
  • Membrane Design: Rational design of selective, water-permeable membranes
  • Contaminant Removal: Removing small charge-neutral contaminants

Funding & Benefits

  • Tuition Fees: Potential coverage for UK students for 3.5-4 years
  • Stipend: Competitive funding may be available for 3.5-4 years
  • Research Costs: Access to computational facilities
  • Training: Training in molecular simulation and machine learning

Eligibility and Requirements

  • Undergraduate degree at 2:1 or above (preferably supported by MSc)
  • Field: Chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, chemistry, physics, materials science, or cognate field
  • Strong background in mathematics and physics
  • Interest in molecular simulation
  • Prior research experience in modelling and simulation (highly desirable)
  • Residency: UK applicants may be supported for competitive studentships

Application Process

  1. Contact supervisor
  2. Discuss research interests
  3. Submit application through Degree Finder
  4. Provide academic documents
  5. Funding competition
  6. Award notification

About the University of Edinburgh

University of Edinburgh is a public research university in Scotland's capital and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across medicine, science, engineering, humanities and social sciences. Its research community supports collaboration across disciplines, connecting academic inquiry with challenges affecting health, technology and society.

Official website: https://www.ed.ac.uk/

  • Competitive funding available.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 2 March 2027. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
